entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate Franchise Tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: $50 annual franchise tax on every domestic and foreign corporation, including S corporations, engaged in business or exercising its franchise in NM (reported on S-Corp return / CIT-1). Does not apply to LLCs taxed as partnerships or disregarded.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Annual election to pay entity-level tax (Section 7-3A-10 NMSA 1978), made by filing the PTE or S-Corp return; binding on all owners; rate not read.

sources.title: NM TRD - Corporate Income & Franchise Tax Overview
sources.quote: New Mexico Corporate Franchise Tax is the obligation of every domestic and foreign corporation, including S corporations

sources.title: NM TRD - Pass-Through Entity
sources.quote: A pass-through entity may elect on an annual basis to pay tax at the entity level for each tax year.

sources.title: NM TRD - Personal Income Tax Information Overview
sources.quote: New Mexico uses a graduated-rate table.

notable: Gross receipts tax generally applies to services, so freelancers usually owe GRT on their receipts (state + local location rate) in addition to income tax; rates vary by location (https://www.tax.newmexico.gov/governments/gross-receipts-location-code-and-tax-rate-map/)
S corporations owe a $50 corporate franchise tax each year (https://www.tax.newmexico.gov/businesses/corporate-income-franchise-tax-overview/)
